SELECT DISTINCT
    e."name",
    e."capacity",
    e."address",
    e."contactinfo"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE 
    (e."name" LIKE '%банкетн%' OR e."name" LIKE '%конференц%')
    AND e."capacity" >= 200;
3:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."food_service", r."cuisine"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE (r."food_service" ILIKE '%restaurant%' OR r."food_service" ILIKE '%cafe%')
  AND r."cuisine" ILIKE '%italian%';
5:
SELECT DISTINCT r.*
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE (r."food_service" ILIKE '%restaurant%' OR r."food_service" ILIKE '%cafe%')
  AND r."cuisine" ILIKE '%Italian%';
6:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "name", "role"
                FROM "staff"
WHERE (LOWER("role") LIKE '%chef%')
   OR (LOWER("role") LIKE '%server%' AND LOWER("language") LIKE '%english%')
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "role", "name" ;
7:
SELECT "id", "name", "role", "language", "additionalcolumn1", "additionalcolumn2", "additionalcolumn3"
FROM "staff"
WHERE ("role" ILIKE '%chef%' OR "role" ILIKE '%server%')
  AND "language" ILIKE '%english%';
108:
SELECT mr."rolename", mr."salary"
FROM "medicalroles" mr
JOIN "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr ON mr."roleid" = hmr."roleid"
GROUP BY mr."roleid", mr."rolename", mr."salary"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hospitals");
109:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT s."name" AS specialist_name,
    sys."system_name" AS system_name
                FROM "it_support_specialists" s
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON s."id" = iss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" sys ON iss."system_id" = sys."system_id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY s."name", sys."system_name" ;
110:
SELECT
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM
    "systems" s
WHERE
    s."system_id" IN (
        SELECT
            iss."system_id"
        FROM
            "it_support_specialists_systems" iss
        GROUP BY
            iss."system_id"
        HAVING
            COUNT(DISTINCT iss."it_specialist_id") = (
                SELECT
                    COUNT(*)
                FROM
                    "it_support_specialists"
            )
    );
111:
SELECT 
    iss."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name" AS system_name,
    s."is_active" AS system_active_status
FROM "it_support_specialists" iss
LEFT JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss_sys ON iss."id" = iss_sys."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN "systems" s ON iss_sys."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY iss."name", s."system_name";
112:
SELECT DISTINCT "r"."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" "r"
WHERE "r"."id" IN (
    SELECT "ir"."responsibilityid"
    FROM "internships_responsibilities" "ir"
    GROUP BY "ir"."responsibilityid"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "ir"."internshipid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "internships")
);
113:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT i."title" AS internship_title,
    r."responsibility" AS responsibility
                FROM "internships" i
INNER JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
INNER JOIN "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY i."title", r."responsibility" ;
114:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "iss"."name" AS "specialist_name",
    "sys"."system_name" AS "system_name"
                FROM "it_support_specialists" "iss"
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" "iss_sys" ON "iss"."id" = "iss_sys"."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" "sys" ON "iss_sys"."system_id" = "sys"."system_id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "specialist_name", "system_name" ;
115:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT i."title" AS internship_title, r."responsibility" AS responsibility
                FROM "internships" i
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY i."title", r."responsibility" ;

SELECT DISTINCT p."title", sd."salary_range", sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "position" p
JOIN "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
WHERE p."title" ILIKE '%software%developer%' OR p."description" ILIKE '%software%developer%';
